    int to, cap, cost, rev;
};

vector<int> dist, prevv, preve;
int n, m, k, c, d;
int S, T;
int X[2000005], Y[2000005];

void add_edge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
    graph[from].push_back({to, cap, cost, (int)graph[to].size()});
    graph[to].push_back({from, 0, -cost, (int)graph[from].size()-1});
}

bool bellman_ford() {
    fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), 1e9);
    dist[S] = 0;
    bool updated = true;
    while (updated) {
        updated = false;
        for (int v = 0; v < graph.size(); ++v) {
            if (dist[v] == 1e9) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < graph[v].size(); ++i) {
                Edge &e = graph[v][i];
                if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[v] + e.cost) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[v] + e.cost;
                    prevv[e.to] = v;
                    preve[e.to] = i;
                    updated = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[T] < 1e9;
}

int min_cost_flow() {
    int flow = 0, cost = 0;
    while (bellman_ford()) {
        int f = 1e9;
        for (int v = T; v != S; v = prevv[v]) {
            f = min(f, graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
        }
        flow += f;
        cost += f * dist[T];
        for (int v = T; v != S; v = prevv[v]) {
            Edge &e = graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
            e.cap -= f;
            graph[v][e.rev].cap += f;
        }
    }
    return cost;
}

    S = 0; T = 1;
    int nodes = 2 + (n + k + 1) * (n + 1);

    dist.resize(nodes);
    prevv.resize(nodes);
    preve.resize(nodes);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        scanf("%d", &x);
        add_edge(S, x + 1, 1, 0);
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        scanf("%d%d", &X[i], &Y[i]);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i <= n + k; ++i) {

        g[to].emplace_back(from, 0, -cost, g[from].size() - 1);
    }

        int total_cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);

                Edge& e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
                e.cap -= flow;
                g[v][e.rev].cap += flow;

        }
        return total_cost;
    }
